entities.summary: Czechoslovak Legions Graveyard in Vladivostok is a graveyard of the Czechoslovak Legions in Vladivostok, Russia. In total there are buried 163 Czechoslovak legionnaires, who fought in the Russian Far East in between 1918 and 1920. In 2005 the graveyard was reconstructed at the expense of the Czech Republic and in May 2006 it was reopened.
